header.name: Point set topology
header.description: The knowledge of Point set topology is inevitable in understanding Analysis, Geometry as well as Algebraic and Differential topology. In a nutshell, we will learn metric spaces, topological spaces, compactness, connectedness, path connectedness and constructing new spaces using quotient topology with number of examples and applications throughout this course. I hope that this course will equip one with the techniques mostly used in the aforementioned topics, and consequently, will help one in further studying Analysis, Geometry (both algebraic and differential), Algebraic and Differential topology or any other fields where the concept/techniques of topology is applied.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students will understand the notion of distance. They will be able to define the notion of “nearness” between elements in a set even without having any particular metric. Along the way, they get used to the basic theory of topological spaces with examples.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to explain the notion of continuity of a function. They get to know the properties of a space which remain invariant under a continuous function, and using these ideas, they should be able to decide whether a function is continuous. Students will be able to construct a global continuous function starting with several locally continuous functions and vice versa.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be familiar with the notion of compactness in both metric and topological spaces, sequential compactness in metric spaces and when these two notions are equivalent.They get to know several application in analysis.

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students will be able to decide whether a space is connected, path-connected. Also, they become familiar with these notions with examples.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Students will understand the notion of quotient topology and get to know how one can “glue” two objects mathematically to obtain a new one, application of these techniques in geometry and topology.

lecture_topics: Topological spaces: Definitions, Examples, Open sets, Closed sets
Basis and Subbasis of a topology
Continuous functions: Definition, Examples, Elementary properties
Constructing continuous functions (local to global and vice versa)
Compact metric spaces and Heine-Borel theorem
Complete metric spaces and Baire Category theorem
Baire spaces and application in analysis
Quotient topology and it’s geometrical applications
